name: Magus Tale Infinity
source: In this Fandisc for the Magus Tale players are able to play new stories with the games characters as well as a full story for a previously sub character. Also included are various fan materials such as wallpapers, musics etc.
translation: 在这部《Magus Tale》Fan Disc中，玩家可以体验以原作角色为主角的新故事，以及一条以原配角为主角的完整路线。此外还收录了壁纸、音乐等各种爱好者向附加内容。
